question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Trailing-four-quarter operating cash flow over net income is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, above the company's own 2025 ({earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}), 2024 ({earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}) and 2023 ({earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}) figures and far above 2022 ({earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}). Accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}, negative as in 2025 ({trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets}) and 2024 ({trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets}) and the opposite sign of 2022 ({trend_table.years-back-3.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets}). On the headline ratios cash backs earnings. The composition is the issue. Working capital absorbs earnings: the year-over-year receivables build is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change}, or {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income|pct} of trailing net income; inventory absorbs {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change} ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.share_of_net_income|pct}); payables supply only {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change} ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.share_of_net_income|pct}). Trade working capital grew by {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.inputs.change_in_trade_working_capital} over the year. What lifts operating cash flow above net income despite that build is the deferred revenue inflow: the release's six-month cash flow statement shows the deferred revenue change as the largest working-capital source, and MD&A ties it to product shipped under acceptance terms and to support contracts. The record holds no computed change in contract liabilities, so its share of the cash-over-income gap is not computed here. Articulation: the receivables gap {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap} and the inventory gap {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap} are zero; the payables gap is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap}, small and not explained in the text (the VeloCloud acquisition's assumed liabilities fall inside the window and could account for it). Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}: quarterly net income moves far less than quarterly operating cash flow. This quarter the two diverged: net income rose {ratios.growth.net_income.quarter_over_quarter|pct} quarter over quarter and {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct} year over year, while the quarter's operating cash flow of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter} fell {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter|pct} quarter over quarter and {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct} year over year. MD&A discusses only the six-month cash flow and gives no reason for the quarterly decline.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: Cash covers earnings on a trailing basis, but the cover comes from customer deferrals rather than collected earned revenue, and the latest quarter's operating cash fell while income rose; earnings quality is acceptable with a timing caveat.

revenue_recognition.finding: Receivables are outrunning revenue. Quarterly days sales outstanding is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, the highest of the six filled quarters, up from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} a quarter earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} a year earlier, and well above the {trend_table.quarters-back-7.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} low of mid-2024; the annual figure for 2025 was {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} for 2024. Receivables over quarterly revenue is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue}, also the highest of the six. The average-balance figure over the trailing four quarters is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding}. The liquidity section of MD&A newly says that certain large customer arrangements include extended payment terms, yet the paragraph that explains the receivables increase cites only higher product and service billings; the cause named in one paragraph is absent from the other. Contract liabilities are moving with revenue, not against it: current contract liabilities over quarterly revenue is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}, second highest of six quarters, down from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} a quarter earlier but up from {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} a year earlier; the current balance is {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities} a year ago, and the total including the non-current portion is larger still. Revenue recognized from opening contract liabilities rose sharply year over year, so a growing share of each quarter's revenue is the release of earlier deferrals. The judgment area is acceptance: MD&A says new products, especially AI Ethernet, bring more customer trials and contracts with acceptance periods, which raise evaluation inventory and product deferred revenue and may make revenue vary by quarter and year. That is a new, substantive judgment area in revenue timing even though deferral itself is conservative. No principal-versus-agent, standalone-selling-price or bill-and-hold wording change is in the notes text. Fourth-quarter concentration cannot be tested because the record has no fourth-quarter cells. Revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} year over year and {ratios.growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter|pct} quarter over quarter, and the 8-K release and the 10-Q print the same quarterly revenue.
revenue_recognition.verdict: Recognition is conservative in form, with large deferrals under acceptance terms, but receivables sit at a six-quarter high alongside newly disclosed extended payment terms; timing risk is rising.

estimates_and_reserves.finding: The three reserve ratios cannot be measured from the tagged record: no allowance for credit losses is tagged in any recent period (the ratio fills only for 2022 at {trend_table.years-back-3.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio} and 2021 at {trend_table.years-back-4.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio}), no inventory valuation reserve is tagged in any period, and no warranty accrual is tagged in any period; thinning cannot be tested, and that absence is itself a finding for a hardware company. Inventory write-downs, which the numbers report quotes for three fiscal years, fell in 2025 to well below the 2024 and 2023 charges while inventory and purchase commitments rose, an estimate that moved in the income-raising direction; no 2026 write-down figure is in the record (terms.trailing_four_quarters.inventory_write_down is missing). Evaluation inventory, finished goods at customers under trial, rose sharply between year-end 2025 and June 2026, and MD&A says that if trial or acceptance requirements are not met the company may have to accept returns and write down inventory. Goodwill shows no impairment, but the VeloCloud purchase price allocation is still described as preliminary a full year after the acquisition date, and the note does not say whether the measurement period is open. The effective tax rate rose: the trailing rate is {tax_rate}, and the quarterly and six-month rates rose year over year because tax benefits from equity-based compensation fell; the rate moved against the company, with no valuation-allowance release and no discrete benefit. Deferred tax assets rose with deferred revenue. Gross unrealized losses on available-for-sale securities rose sharply from year-end while the loss-aging table was collapsed to a single bucket and the longer-dated bucket is described only as not material, so the longer-dated loss amount is no longer stated.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: Reserves are unobservable in the tagged record, the one visible estimate (inventory write-downs) moved favourably to income while risk indicators rose, and the tax rate moved against the company; mixed, leaning cautious.

cost_deferral.finding: No software development cost is capitalized in the tagged record, and research and development is expensed at {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense} over the trailing four quarters, rising year over year, so the capitalized-versus-expensed test has nothing to flag. What is deferred is cost of sales: current deferred costs rose markedly from year-end 2025 to June 2026 alongside deferred product revenue, prepaid and other current assets rose, and other non-current assets rose. Soft assets over total assets are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}, the highest of six quarters, up from {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.soft_asset_share} a year earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-7.ratios.soft_asset_share} two years earlier; the annual figure for 2025 was {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share} against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share} for 2024, the highest of five years. Much of that is marketable securities, but deferred costs, deferred tax assets and contract-manufacturer deposits are also growing. The deferred cost matches deferred revenue and is proper matching, but its recoverability rests on customer acceptance. Non-GAAP: the gap between non-GAAP and GAAP net income is not computed in the record because no non-GAAP measure is tagged. The release's reconciliation shows intangible amortization added back at a much larger amount than a year earlier after VeloCloud, and share-based compensation excluded every quarter; both recur. The non-GAAP tax method changed in the fourth quarter of 2025, and the retrospective recast raised prior-year non-GAAP net income, so the release's year-over-year non-GAAP growth is measured against a lifted base.
cost_deferral.verdict: No classic cost capitalization; deferred cost of sales and soft assets are at their highest share and the non-GAAP presentation was re-based upward; moderate concern.

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: Receivables factoring: the record tags no proceeds from sale of receivables (terms.trailing_four_quarters.proceeds_from_sale_of_receivables is missing) and the notes text describes none. Supplier finance: no supplier finance obligation is tagged (terms.balances_now.supplier_finance_obligation is missing) and none is described. Purchase obligations: the calculator's unconditional purchase obligation field is missing, but the numbers report quotes non-cancellable purchase commitments that rose from year-end 2025 through March to June 2026, with nearly all due within twelve months, an amount larger than the trailing-four-quarter cost of revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue}. A sentence saying purchase obligations also cover software licences, property and corporate goods was removed from the note, so the March and June amounts may not be on the same basis. Deposits to contract manufacturers to secure those commitments rose from year-end and sit in prepaid and other assets. Guarantees: no maximum exposure is tagged (terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure is missing); the guarantees paragraph is unchanged. Leases: the current filing states no operating lease liability in the record; the calculator carries a stale figure of {ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability} from year-end 2024. Variable-interest entities: none are mentioned, and MD&A says there are no off-balance-sheet arrangements. Classification: the 10-K tags capital spending under a different concept than the 10-Qs; trailing capital expenditure is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure}; nothing moves between operating and investing. Share-based compensation is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} over the trailing four quarters, rising year over year, with a large unamortized balance still to be expensed; it is a real cost and is already subtracted in free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted ({free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted} against simple free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}). Share repurchases were nil in the first half of 2026 against a large outflow a year earlier, so trailing repurchases of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases} understate the historical pace and the cash build partly reflects the pause. The financing paragraph refers to taxes paid under stock repurchase plans in a period with no repurchases.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: No factoring or supplier-finance lift is visible; the off-balance-sheet exposure is purchase commitments, which are large, rising and possibly rebased; attention warranted.

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding: Disclosure controls are concluded effective as of the quarter end and no change in internal control over financial reporting is reported; there is no material weakness or remediation language. No auditor change: the 8-K item list shows no Item 4.01 or 4.02 and no late-filing notice on or before the cutoff. Critical audit matters do not apply to a 10-Q, and the interim review report, the prior Item 4 wording, the risk-factor diff, the subsidiary list and any SEC comment letters are not in the input. No chief financial officer, chief accounting officer or controller departure is disclosed; the chief financial officer modified her trading plan and a director adopted one, which are insider selling arrangements rather than departures, and are new disclosures this quarter. Prior-period values: GAAP comparatives are not restated, but all prior non-GAAP results were recast upward under the new tax method, a quiet re-basing of the non-GAAP history. Related parties: nothing in the notes text. The filing is timely.
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: Clean on controls, auditor and filing signals; the only re-basing is of non-GAAP comparatives.

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: The 8-K release and the 10-Q agree on the figures they share: quarterly revenue of {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter}, quarterly net income of {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}, a GAAP gross margin that the release prints at the same value as the trend cell {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, and six-month operating cash flow. Where they differ is narrative. The release calls the quarter strong, broad-based growth; the 10-Q attributes the gross margin decline to a larger share of sales to large end customers who receive higher discounts, and attributes the Non-Americas share movement to the geographic mix of large global customers. The release's headline non-GAAP EPS growth is measured against a comparative recast upward under the new tax method, and the CFO quote does not say which EPS measure it cites. Of the notes items that carry a direction, the numbers confirm nearly all; the sales-and-marketing and general-and-administrative items are unresolved because those lines are not itemized in the numbers report, and the broad-based-growth item is contradicted by the margin explanation and the concentration facts.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: Figures reconcile across documents; the two documents' descriptions of where growth came from do not.

industry_lens.finding: Inventory obsolescence: days sales of inventory is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, the lowest of six quarters, down from {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} a year earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-7.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} two years earlier ({ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory} on an average-balance basis), so inventory is turning faster even as the balance rises; but raw materials and evaluation inventory rose markedly from year-end, the 2025 write-down fell well below the prior two years, no inventory reserve is tagged, and MD&A warns of a heightened risk of excess or obsolete inventory and supplier liability charges. Purchase commitments in excess of need: commitments due within twelve months, as quoted, exceed the trailing-four-quarter cost of revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue}; management attributes them to AI network deployment and tightening memory and silicon supply. Customer concentration (annual facts from the 10-K; no quarterly facts in the record): Reseller B rose from {concentration.facts.1.value|pct} of revenue in 2023 to {concentration.facts.3.value|pct} in 2024 and {concentration.facts.6.value|pct} in 2025, while Reseller A went from {concentration.facts.0.value|pct} to {concentration.facts.2.value|pct} to {concentration.facts.5.value|pct}; receivables are far more concentrated, with Reseller A holding {concentration.facts.7.value|pct} of accounts receivable at end-2025 and Reseller B {concentration.facts.4.value|pct} at end-2024. Channel stuffing: shipments under acceptance terms are deferred rather than recognized, which argues against recognition-based stuffing; but evaluation inventory at customer sites rose sharply, days sales outstanding is at a six-quarter high and extended payment terms for large customers are newly disclosed, so the physical channel is fuller than a year ago. Circular or vendor-financed deals: the release excludes gains on strategic investments, so the company holds investments in other companies, but nothing in the notes text links an investee to purchases from the company; nothing found beyond the existence of the investments.
industry_lens.verdict: Inventory turns are improving, but reseller concentration, receivables concentration, trial inventory and purchase commitments all point the same way: rising dependence on a few large customers and on acceptance.

anomalies.what: Net income rose {ratios.growth.net_income.quarter_over_quarter|pct} quarter over quarter and {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct} year over year, while the quarter's operating cash flow fell {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter|pct} and {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct}. MD&A explains only the six-month cash flow and gives no reason for the quarterly decline.

anomalies.name: Income is much smoother than cash
anomalies.what: The smoothness ratio is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}, far below one: quarterly net income steps up steadily while quarterly operating cash flow swings widely. Nothing in the text addresses the quarterly cash volatility.

anomalies.name: Operating cash exceeds income because of deferred revenue
anomalies.what: Operating cash flow over net income is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} and accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}, yet receivables, inventory and deferred costs all absorbed cash; the gap is filled by the deferred revenue inflow that MD&A ties to product shipped under acceptance terms. The cash arrives before the revenue is earned, so the excess is timing, not conservatism in earnings.

anomalies.name: Small payables articulation gap
anomalies.what: The balance-sheet change in payables of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change} differs from the cash-flow statement's change by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap}; receivables and inventory articulate exactly. The VeloCloud acquisition's assumed liabilities sit inside the window and could explain it, but the text does not say.

anomalies.what: The 10-K tags capital spending as payments to acquire productive assets while the 10-Qs use payments to acquire property, plant and equipment; the trailing figure of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} mixes the two. The filing text does not address it.

anomalies.name: Share-based compensation rising with a large unamortized balance
anomalies.what: Share-based compensation is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} over the trailing four quarters and the quarterly expense rose year over year; the note quotes a large unamortized cost still to be recognized. It is a real cost already subtracted in free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted ({free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}).

anomalies.name: Repurchase-plan taxes cited in a period with no repurchases
anomalies.name_ko: 자사주 매입 없는 기간에 매입계획 관련 세금 언급
anomalies.what: The financing paragraph attributes the outflow partly to taxes paid under stock repurchase plans, while repurchases for the six months are nil and the trailing figure is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases}; the text does not say what those taxes were.

anomalies.name: Chief financial officer modified her trading plan
anomalies.what: A new disclosure that the chief financial officer modified her trading arrangement to sell shares earned from performance-based awards through year-end 2026. Not a departure; no number tests it.

anomalies.name: Director adopted a trading plan
anomalies.what: A new disclosure that a director adopted a trading arrangement to sell shares through mid-2027. No number tests it.

anomalies.name: Non-GAAP history quietly recast
anomalies.what: All prior-period non-GAAP results in the release were recast to the new tax method; GAAP figures are untouched. The comparatives in the release are not the figures first reported.

anomalies.name: Release says broad-based growth; filing says large-customer mix
anomalies.name_ko: 실적발표는 광범위한 성장, 공시는 대형고객 비중 확대
anomalies.what: The 8-K CFO quote calls the growth broad-based; the 10-Q attributes the gross margin decline to a larger share of sales to large end customers with higher discounts. Quarterly gross margin is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.gross_margin|pct} a year earlier, and Reseller B's annual revenue share rose to {concentration.facts.6.value|pct} in 2025 from {concentration.facts.3.value|pct} in 2024.

anomalies.name: EPS growth headline measured on a recast base
anomalies.name_ko: EPS 성장률 헤드라인이 재작성된 기준치 대비
anomalies.what: The release's headline non-GAAP EPS growth and the CFO's EPS-up remark are measured against a prior-year non-GAAP figure raised by the tax method change; the CFO quote does not say which EPS measure it cites. GAAP net income grew {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct}.

anomalies.name: Receivables concentrated in a single reseller
anomalies.what: Reseller A held {concentration.facts.7.value|pct} of accounts receivable at end-2025 and Reseller B {concentration.facts.4.value|pct} at end-2024, far above their revenue shares of {concentration.facts.5.value|pct} and {concentration.facts.3.value|pct}; with days sales outstanding at a six-quarter high, collection risk sits with very few counterparties. The 10-Q text does not discuss concentration.

anomalies.name: Reseller B revenue share rising
anomalies.what: Reseller B's share of annual revenue went from {concentration.facts.1.value|pct} in 2023 to {concentration.facts.3.value|pct} in 2024 and {concentration.facts.6.value|pct} in 2025, while Reseller A's went from {concentration.facts.0.value|pct} to {concentration.facts.2.value|pct} to {concentration.facts.5.value|pct}. The 10-Q attributes the margin decline to large end customers with higher discounts.

anomalies.name: Trial inventory at customer sites rising while overall turns improve
anomalies.name_ko: 전체 재고회전은 개선되나 고객 시험용 재고는 증가
anomalies.what: Days sales of inventory is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, the lowest of six quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} a year earlier, yet evaluation inventory at customers and raw materials rose markedly from year-end and the physical channel is fuller. MD&A names trials and acceptance periods as the cause.

anomalies.name: Purchase commitments exceed trailing cost of revenue
anomalies.what: Commitments due within twelve months, as quoted, are larger than the trailing-four-quarter cost of revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue}, and inventory on hand is {terms.balances_now.inventory}; management says the commitments secure memory and silicon supply for AI deployments and warns of supplier liability charges if demand shifts.

anomalies.name: Strategic investments held, no customer link disclosed
anomalies.name_ko: 전략적 투자 보유, 고객 연계 공시 없음
anomalies.what: The release excludes gains on strategic investments from non-GAAP income, so the company invests in other companies; nothing in the notes text says whether any investee buys from the company. Circular dealing cannot be confirmed or ruled out from this record.

adjustments.name: Receivables growth tied to newly disclosed extended payment terms
adjustments.quote: Additionally, our working capital and operating cash flows may experience timing differences as a result of certain large customer arrangements that include extended payment terms.

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 최근 4개 분기 영업현금흐름 대비 순이익 비율은 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}로 2025년의 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}보다 높고 발생액 비율은 {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}로 음수이지만, 이 초과분은 검수 조건부 선적에 따른 이연수익 유입에서 나온 것이며 매출채권 증가 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change}와 재고 증가 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change}가 현금을 흡수했다. 이번 분기에는 순이익이 전분기 대비 {ratios.growth.net_income.quarter_over_quarter|pct} 늘었는데 분기 영업현금흐름은 {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter|pct} 줄었고 매끄러움 비율 {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}는 이익이 현금보다 훨씬 안정적임을 보여준다.
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 분기 매출채권회전일수가 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}로 여섯 분기 중 최고이고 1년 전 {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}보다 높은데, 경영진은 대형 고객의 연장 지급조건을 새로 언급하면서도 매출채권 증가 원인으로는 청구액 증가만 들었다. 유동 계약부채 대비 매출 비율은 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}로 검수기간이 있는 계약의 이연이 매출 인식 시점을 좌우하는 새로운 판단 영역이 되었다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 대손충당금·재고평가충당금·보증충당금은 태그되지 않아 충당금 비율을 측정할 수 없고, 2025년 재고 평가손실은 전 두 해보다 크게 줄어든 반면 재고와 구매약정, 고객 시험용 재고는 늘었다. 유효세율은 {tax_rate}로 주식보상 세제혜택 감소 때문에 올라 회사에 불리한 방향으로 움직였고, VeloCloud 인수가격 배분은 1년이 지나도 잠정으로 남아 있다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 소프트웨어 개발비 자본화는 없고 연구개발비 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense}는 전액 비용 처리되었지만, 이연수익과 짝을 이루는 이연원가가 크게 늘어 무형성 자산 비중이 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}로 여섯 분기 중 최고가 되었다. 비GAAP 세금 산정 방법 변경으로 전년 비교치가 상향 재작성되어 발표된 비GAAP 성장률은 높아진 기준치 대비이다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 매출채권 매각이나 공급망 금융은 기록에 없고, 부외 항목으로는 취소 불가능한 구매약정이 최근 4개 분기 매출원가 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue}보다 큰 규모로 늘었으며 그 범위를 설명하던 문장이 삭제되었다. 주식보상비용 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}는 실제 비용으로 이미 품질조정 잉여현금흐름 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}에서 차감되어 있다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 공시통제는 유효하다고 결론지었고 내부통제 변경, 중요한 취약점, 감사인 교체, 지연 제출은 없다. 최고재무책임자의 거래계획 수정과 이사의 거래계획 채택이 새로 공시되었고 비GAAP 과거 실적만 조용히 재작성되었다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 8-K 실적발표와 10-Q는 분기 매출 {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter}, 순이익 {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}, 매출총이익률 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}에서 일치한다. 그러나 실적발표는 광범위한 성장이라 하고 10-Q는 할인율이 높은 대형 고객 비중 확대로 마진이 하락했다고 설명해 성장의 출처에 대한 서술이 서로 다르다.
summary_ko.industry_lens: 재고회전일수는 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}로 여섯 분기 중 가장 짧아졌지만 고객 시험용 재고와 원재료가 크게 늘었고 구매약정은 매출원가 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue}를 넘는다. 리셀러 B의 매출 비중은 {concentration.facts.6.value|pct}로 올랐고 리셀러 A는 2025년 말 매출채권의 {concentration.facts.7.value|pct}를 차지해 소수 고객과 검수 판단에 대한 의존이 커지고 있다.

limits: This analysis finds where the numbers and the explanations disagree, and where the company differs from its own past. It does not judge intent, and it cannot see evidence outside the filings, such as invoices or contracts.
